description: Feature configuration for fraud detection model

features.name: amount
features.description: Transaction amount

features.name: log_amount
features.description: Log-transformed amount

features.name: is_cash_out
features.description: 1 if transaction type is CASH_OUT

features.name: is_transfer
features.description: 1 if transaction type is TRANSFER

features.name: balance_usage_ratio
features.description: Ratio of amount used from available balance

velocity_features.description: Temporal velocity and frequency features (historical only)

features.name: txn_count_1h
features.description: Transaction count by sender in last 1 hour (BEFORE current)

features.name: txn_count_24h
features.description: Transaction count by sender in last 24 hours (BEFORE current)

features.name: amount_sum_1h
features.description: Sum of amounts by sender in last 1 hour (BEFORE current)

features.name: amount_sum_24h
features.description: Sum of amounts by sender in last 24 hours (BEFORE current)

features.name: unique_destinations_1h
features.description: Unique destination accounts by sender in last 1 hour

features.name: unique_destinations_24h
features.description: Unique destination accounts by sender in last 24 hours

features.name: account_age_steps
features.description: Steps since first activity for this account

features.name: is_new_account
features.description: 1 if account age < 30 days

features.name: historical_avg_amount
features.description: Average amount for this sender (BEFORE current transaction)

features.name: historical_std_amount
features.description: Std dev of amounts for this sender (BEFORE current)

features.name: amount_zscore
features.description: Z-score of amount vs historical for this sender

features.name: new_beneficiary_flag
features.description: 1 if first time this sender sends to this recipient

features.name: beneficiary_receive_frequency
features.description: How many times has this destination received from this sender

graph_features.description: Graph/network-based features from synthetic data patterns

features.name: cycle_detected
features.description: 1 if transaction is part of circular flow pattern

features.name: cycle_length
features.description: Length of cycle if detected

features.name: fan_in_score
features.description: Number of unique senders to this destination in time window

features.name: fan_out_score
features.description: Number of unique destinations from this sender in time window

features.name: destination_concentration
features.description: Concentration of transactions to single destination (0-1)

scenario_metadata.description: Metadata from synthetic labeled data (training only)

features.name: scenario_type
features.description: Type of scenario (fraud pattern) - for understanding

features.name: severity
features.description: Severity level assigned by synthetic data generator

training_notes.class_imbalance: Expected to be extreme in real paysim dataset; synthetic data is 50-50 for validation
training_notes.scaling: XGBoost/RF don't require scaling; Isolation Forest may benefit from standardization
training_notes.missing_values: Filled with domain-appropriate defaults per column
training_notes.categorical_encoding: High-cardinality fields (account IDs) not one-hot encoded; instead converted to behavioral features
